page: spec/stdlib.md section 11.1, with the names of spec/language.md section 3.8
what: The channel values of the named colours. stdlib.md 11.1 fixes them in the library manifest and makes them part of the conformance suite, so that a study looks the same on every engine; this file is that part of the manifest in machine form. Each entry is red, green and blue as whole numbers from 0 to 255, at the full opacity 11.1 states, which compiled-program.md 2.9 writes as an alpha of 1. scripts/check-colour-channels.mjs holds the compiler's table and the engine's table to this file and states no value of its own.
